Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，在吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, you there?

Content.SourceString: 嗯……不知道鉴定师对都市传说感不感兴趣？
Content.LocalizedString: I was just wondering… are you interested in urban legends?

Content.SourceString: 是那种……在某个地方流传着奇怪故事，然后大家都说自己遇到过的传说吗？
Content.LocalizedString: You mean the kind of thing… where some weird rumor starts making the rounds somewhere, and then everyone claims they've seen it themselves?

Content.SourceString: 虽然不一定是真的，但那些离奇的传闻和背后的故事，听起来还挺有意思的。
Content.LocalizedString: They might not be true, but those weird rumors and the stories behind them are still pretty interesting.

Content.SourceString: 嗯！最近呗果上有很多关于噗卡乐园的传说呢，大家都说，噗卡乐园似乎连接着一个「异世界」。
Content.LocalizedString: Mhm! Bagel's been buzzing with urban legends about Pukaland lately—people say it seems to connect to an "Other World."

Content.SourceString: 有人说，噗卡乐园有通往「异世界」的通道，也有人说，可以找到噗卡集团创始人留下的宝库，或者遇到会让人性情大变的神秘空间……
Content.LocalizedString: Some say Pukaland has a passage to the "Other World." Others say you can find the Puka Group founder's hidden vault—or stumble into a mysterious space that completely changes who you are…

Content.SourceString: 会是异象空间吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Could it be one of the Anomalous Realms?

Content.SourceString: 从水晶球中看没什么异常，不过鉴定师想不想一起去噗卡乐园看看？
Content.LocalizedString: I haven't seen anything unusual in my crystal ball. So, Appraiser, wish to go check out Pukaland together?

Content.SourceString: 星星眼.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: starstruck.jpg

Content.SourceString: 噗卡乐园游客应该很多吧，黑羽可以吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Pukaland will probably be pretty crowded. You okay with that, Blackbird?

Content.SourceString: 如果是为了探访都市传说的话……
Content.LocalizedString: If it's to check out urban legends…

Content.SourceString: 可以。
Content.LocalizedString: Then it'll be alright.

Content.SourceString: 这可是给「乌鸫面」积累素材的好机会！
Content.LocalizedString: This is the perfect chance to gather material for Ravenoli!

OptionText.LocalizedString: So it's for work material after all.
Let's not waste any time, then.

Content.SourceString: 原来是黑羽作为呗主的工作。
Content.LocalizedString: So this is part of your work as a Bagel creator.

Content.SourceString: 那就一起去逛逛吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Let's go take a look around together!

Content.SourceString: 我记得之前黑羽也说过想多看看海特洛呢。
Content.LocalizedString: I recall you saying you wanted to see more of Hethereau, too.

Content.SourceString: 噗卡乐园见。
Content.LocalizedString: See you at Pukaland.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师……
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser…

Content.SourceString: 笑.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: laughing.jpg

Content.SourceString: 黑羽怎么了？
Content.LocalizedString: What's up, Blackbird?

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师最近一定没有刷呗果吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, you haven't been scrolling through Bagel lately, have you?

Content.SourceString: 是有段时间没看了。
Content.LocalizedString: I haven't checked it in a while.

Content.SourceString: 是呗果上有什么新消息吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Anything new on Bagel?

Content.SourceString: 那鉴定师一定不知道现在是谁在跟你发消息吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Then I bet you have no idea who's texting you right now!

Content.SourceString: 不是黑羽吗？
Content.LocalizedString: You're Blackbird, right?

Content.SourceString: 难道黑羽被盗号了？
Content.LocalizedString: Did your account get hacked or something?

Content.SourceString: 哼哼，现在的我已经不是去噗卡乐园之前的我了！你看——
Content.LocalizedString: Heh-heh, I'm not the same as I was before Pukaland anymore! Just look—

Content.SourceString: 「救命妈妈我好像在噗卡乐园看见鬼了！」——引自呗果
Content.LocalizedString: "Mom, help! I think I just saw a ghost at Pukaland!" —Quoted from Bagel

Content.SourceString: 「在噗卡乐园明明看见个黑衣服的冷脸姐姐，可是好像只有我一个人看见了怎么办啊啊啊啊！」——引自呗果
Content.LocalizedString: "I swear I saw this stone-faced lady in black at Pukaland, but it feels like I was the only one who saw her—what am I supposed to dooooo?!" —Quoted from Bagel

Content.SourceString: 好像……一不小心就成为新的都市传说了？
Content.LocalizedString: It looks like… I accidentally became a new urban legend myself?

Content.SourceString: 我应该谢谢鉴定师？
Content.LocalizedString: So, I should thank you, right?

Content.SourceString: 这可以成为「乌鸫面」女士的新素材吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Could this be new material for Ms. Ravenoli?

Content.SourceString: 一定是因为那天黑羽的演技太好了。
Content.LocalizedString: Your acting that day must've been a little too convincing.

Content.SourceString: 灵异区up主以身入局！我揭秘我自己？
Content.LocalizedString: A paranormal creator becomes part of the mystery! Am I about to debunk myself?

Content.SourceString: 默契配合哟。
Content.LocalizedString: Wow, our synergy is outta this world, huh?

Content.SourceString: 听说现在在呗果上去噗卡乐园偶遇「黑衣女子」已经变成新的打卡项目了。
Content.LocalizedString: I hear people on Bagel are now visiting Pukaland hoping to spot the "Woman in Black."

Content.SourceString: 看来之前那个游客真的相信自己遇到了「奇迹」……
Content.LocalizedString: Looks like that tourist really thought they'd witnessed a "miracle"…

Content.SourceString: 下次再去的话，不知道能不能再送给哪个幸运儿一个「奇迹」呢。
Content.LocalizedString: If we go back next time, I wonder if we'll get to give another lucky soul a "miracle."

Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser—are you there? Are you there?

Content.LocalizedString: Blackbird, Blackbird, I'm here, I'm here!

Content.LocalizedString: "Auto-Reply": The user you're looking for is currently en route. Please wait a moment.

Content.LocalizedString: What's up?

Content.SourceString: 刚刚不在，现在在了。
Content.LocalizedString: I wasn't around for a sec, but I'm here now.

Content.LocalizedString: I… I got two movie tickets…

Content.SourceString: 然后我发现……你和我加起来正好是两个人！
Content.LocalizedString: And then I realized… you and I add up to exactly two people!

Content.SourceString: 天下竟然有这么巧的事！
Content.LocalizedString: What a coincidence?!

Content.SourceString: 是吧是吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Right? Right!

Content.SourceString: 所以……要不要一起去看电影……
Content.LocalizedString: So… do you want to go see a movie together…

Content.LocalizedString: starstruck.jpg

Content.SourceString: 既然是黑羽的邀约，那我当然会去
Content.LocalizedString: Of course, I'll go if you're the one inviting me.

Content.LocalizedString: See you at the movie theater

Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser—are you free right now?

Content.LocalizedString: I want to invite you to go somewhere.

Content.LocalizedString: So, where are we headed today, Blackbird?

Content.SourceString: 其实是一件委托……想拜托鉴定师和我一起去qwq
Content.LocalizedString: Actually, it's a commission… Could you come with me, Appraiser? qwq

Content.LocalizedString: Someone claiming to be the photo studio owner contacted me. He said he wanted to ask for advice.

Content.SourceString: 我正准备飞去照相馆，具体情况我们见面再聊
Content.LocalizedString: I'm about to fly over to the photo studio—I'll fill you in when we meet.

Content.LocalizedString: If you have time, come by The Witch's House.

Content.LocalizedString: Don't worry! I won't drag you all over town with me again today (^^)

Content.LocalizedString: I'll be waiting for you at my place.

Content.SourceString: 海特洛有什么好玩的地方吗？
Content.LocalizedString: What are some fun places to check out in Hethereau?

OptionText.LocalizedString: I know of a few places.

Content.SourceString: 当然啦，海特洛可是很大的，既有热闹的商业街，也有充满活力的噗咔乐园，还有风景美丽的郊区……
Content.LocalizedString: Hethereau is huge. It's got a bustling commercial district, lively Pukaland, and beautiful suburbs…

Content.SourceString: 我觉得黑羽说不定会很喜欢伊波恩……
Content.LocalizedString: I think Blackbird might really like Eibon…

Content.SourceString: 其实我最近正在呗果上搜索各种海特洛旅游攻略
Content.LocalizedString: Actually, I've been looking up all kinds of travel guides for Hethereau on Bagel lately.

Content.SourceString: 然后我想到拉维尼娅说鉴定师对海特洛很熟悉，所以就来问问，嘿嘿
Content.LocalizedString: Then I remembered Lavinia saying the Appraiser knows Hethereau really well, so I figured I'd ask you first, hehe.

Content.SourceString: 看来果然没有找错人
Content.LocalizedString: Looks like I really came to the right person after all.

OptionText.LocalizedString: Where would you like to go?

Content.SourceString: 黑羽有没有很想去的地方？
Content.LocalizedString: Is there anywhere you really want to go, Blackbird?

Content.SourceString: 唔……说起来，我比较想去热闹一些的地方……
Content.LocalizedString: Um… come to think of it, I'd rather go somewhere a bit more lively…

Content.SourceString: 但是总感觉人太多，我坚持不到一分钟就会变成乌鸫逃走的，呜
Content.LocalizedString: But when there are too many people around, I don't think I'd last a minute before turning into a blackbird and flying away…

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师有没有什么克服社恐的好方法？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, do you have any tips for getting over my social anxiety?

Content.SourceString: 星星眼.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: starstruck.jpg

Content.SourceString: 越是这种情况，越应该到人多的场合锻炼自己！
Content.LocalizedString: All the more reason to put yourself in situations with lots of people and get some practice!

Content.SourceString: 或许可以尝试将其他人都想象成……黑羽喜欢的动漫角色？
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe you could try imagining everyone else as… anime characters you like?

Content.SourceString: ！原来是这样
Content.LocalizedString: Oh! I could try that!

Content.SourceString: 为了能和鉴定师顺利地出门逛街……我，我会努力的！
Content.LocalizedString: So that I can go shopping with the Appraiser without a hitch… I… I'll do my best!

Content.SourceString: 我之后再来约你哦，鉴定师
Content.LocalizedString: I'll ask you to hang out again sometime, Appraiser

Content.LocalizedString: determined.jpg

Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser

Content.SourceString: 你有没有喜欢的动漫
Content.LocalizedString: Do you have a favorite anime?

OptionText.LocalizedString: Not off the top of my head

Content.SourceString: 当然，一下子都说不完呢
Content.LocalizedString: Of course—I couldn't possibly name them all.

Content.SourceString: 唔，被黑羽这么问，一时间好像想不起来……
Content.LocalizedString: Um… Now that you ask, I suddenly can't seem to recall a single name…

Content.SourceString: 嘿嘿，其实我准备在呗果上开一个「今日好番」系列的专栏
Content.LocalizedString: Hehe, I'm actually thinking of starting a "Today's Anime Picks" column on Bagel.

Content.SourceString: 以前做电影相关的内容比较多，现在想尝试换个赛道
Content.LocalizedString: I used to work mostly on movie-related content, but now I wanna try something different.

Content.SourceString: 老是出同样的内容，大家总会看腻的
Content.LocalizedString: People get bored if you keep posting about the same stuff, you know.

Content.SourceString: 不过比起来电影，我看的番剧相对少一些，就想着补补番
Content.LocalizedString: Compared to movies, though, I haven't watched as much anime, so I figured I'd catch up on some popular series.

Content.SourceString: 黑羽还真是相当称职的呗主啊
Content.LocalizedString: Blackbird's a pretty dedicated content creator, huh.

Content.SourceString: 我觉得粉丝们一定也会喜欢的
Content.LocalizedString: I think the fans will be super into it.

Content.SourceString: 我也是这么想的
Content.LocalizedString: I was thinking the same thing.

Content.SourceString: 骄傲.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: Proud.jpg

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师如果有什么推荐的，一定要记得告诉我哦
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, if you have any recommendations, be sure to let me know, okay?

Content.SourceString: 星星眼.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: starstruck.jpg

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，你有没有看到呗果上那条关于我的怪谈？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, have you seen that urban legend about me on Bagel?

Content.SourceString: 是不是怪谈bot新发的那条？
Content.LocalizedString: Is that the one the urban legend bot just posted?

Content.SourceString: 我现在去看
Content.LocalizedString: I'll go take a look.

Content.SourceString: 我觉得大家的想法都很好玩
Content.LocalizedString: I'm really loving everyone's ideas.

Content.SourceString: 邪恶的魔女什么的……听着就很酷！
Content.LocalizedString: An evil witch… That sounds so cool!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师觉得，我是不是应该往大家「期待」的风格靠拢一下？
Content.LocalizedString: Do you think I should lean a little more into the style everyone "expects" of me?

Content.SourceString: 比如把魔女之家的灯都换成鬼火，书架上放一些蜘蛛网装饰，再养一只黑猫……
Content.LocalizedString: For example, replace all the lamps in The Witch's House with will-o'-wisps, add some spiderweb decorations to the bookshelf, and maybe even adopt a black cat…

Content.SourceString: 想想就很恐怖呢
Content.LocalizedString: Just thinking about it is a little scary…

Content.SourceString: 这是要黑化的节奏了吗？！
Content.LocalizedString: Is this the start of your villain arc?!

Content.SourceString: 我还是更喜欢现在的黑羽
Content.LocalizedString: I prefer the way you are now.

Content.SourceString: 开个玩笑啦：D
Content.LocalizedString: Just kidding :DDDD

Content.SourceString: 我只是喜欢听一些这样那样的怪谈小故事
Content.LocalizedString: I just like listening to weird little stories—urban legends and the like.

Content.SourceString: 要是真的把大家吓到了，我应该会感到愧疚吧
Content.LocalizedString: If I genuinely scared everyone for real, I'd feel super guilty…

Content.SourceString: 哼歌.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: Humming.jpg

Content.SourceString: 黑羽这是……？
Content.LocalizedString: What's this about, Blackbird…?

Content.SourceString: 看来黑羽的心情不错？
Content.LocalizedString: You seem to be in a pretty good mood?

Content.SourceString: 因为最近收到的谕石变少了，感觉很开心^^
Content.LocalizedString: I'm pretty happy lately, actually—I've been getting fewer Oracle Stones ^^

Content.SourceString: 这说明世界上的负面情绪在减少，我的工作也在相应地减少
Content.LocalizedString: This means there's less negative emotion in the world, so I have less work to do as well.

Content.SourceString: 怎么想都是一件值得庆祝的事呢
Content.LocalizedString: No matter what, it's a matter worth celebrating.

Content.SourceString: 这么一说，还真是
Content.LocalizedString: Come to think of it, yeah, you're right

Content.SourceString: 当然也少不了鉴定师的功劳！
Content.LocalizedString: And I couldn't have done it without the Appraiser's help!

Content.SourceString: 星星眼.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: starstruck.jpg

Content.SourceString: 那些鸟儿们有时会迷路，多亏了鉴定师把它们找到的谕石送来我这里
Content.LocalizedString: Those silly birds sometimes get lost. Thankfully, the Appraiser brings me the Oracle Stones they find for me.

Content.SourceString: 这都不算什么啦
Content.LocalizedString: It's really no sweat off my back.

Content.SourceString: 这样的话，我有没有什么奖励？
Content.LocalizedString: Are you gonna reward me for all my hard work?

Content.SourceString: 我想想……
Content.LocalizedString: Let me think…

Content.SourceString: 为了感谢鉴定师，看来是时候再去翻翻我的收藏了
Content.LocalizedString: To thank the Appraiser, I think it's time to dig through my collection again.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师知道天上有多少颗星星吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, do you know how many stars are up in the sky?

Content.SourceString: 真的会有人知道星星的数量吗……
Content.LocalizedString: Does anyone actually know how many stars there are…

Content.SourceString: 怎么突然问起这个？
Content.LocalizedString: Why are you asking about that all of a sudden?

Content.SourceString: 其实我看星星的时候经常会想到这个问题
Content.LocalizedString: Questions like that are always on my mind when I'm looking at the stars.

Content.SourceString: 我也尝试数过，但总是数着数着就睡着了
Content.LocalizedString: I've tried counting them too, but I always end up falling asleep before I can count them all.

Content.SourceString: 叹气.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: sigh.jpg

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师不觉得星空很奇妙吗？它们从亿万年前就挂在空中，什么秘密都逃不过它们的眼睛
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, don't you find the starry sky amazing? Those stars have hung there for billions of years, and no secret can escape their gaze.

Content.SourceString: 真的有种梦幻的感觉呢
Content.LocalizedString: It really does feel dreamlike.

Content.SourceString: 是吧是吧，尤其是作为占卜师，星空可是我们要面对的最深奥的谜题
Content.LocalizedString: Right? Right? Especially for those of us who practice divination, the starry sky is the deepest mystery we have to face

Content.SourceString: 终有一天我会解明所有的答案的，到那时……
Content.LocalizedString: One day, I'll uncover all the answers. And when that day comes…

Content.SourceString: 总之，鉴定师也为我加油吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Anyway, Appraiser, root for me!
